items.definition:
have (something) as one's own property; possess
I own a small car.

to make happy or satisfied
He tried to please his parents.

to put or place; to establish
Please set the table for dinner.

give assistance to
We support local businesses.

contain as part of a whole
The price includes tax.

use as a foundation
The movie is based on a true story.

manage
He can control his emotions.

distribute, handle
How do you deal with stress?

kill
The hunter tried to kill the animal.

to guide; to be in charge
She will lead the team on the new project.

to teach or prepare someone for a particular job or activity
We need to train new employees.

supply, give
We need to provide more information.

to include or affect someone or something
The project will involve a lot of teamwork.

relate
I can relate to your feelings.

bear
I can't bear the thought of losing you.

consider
Please consider my offer.

print and distribute
The author will publish a new book next year.

to bring something into existence
Artists create beautiful works of art.

to let someone do something
My parents allow me to stay out late.

to give an account of in words
Can you describe the suspect?

to make a public statement about something
They will announce the winner tomorrow.

to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate
The city plans to develop a new park.

to fit
Does this shirt still fit you?

to estimate, measure, or note the similarity or dissimilarity between
Let's compare the two options.

to keep safe from harm
Parents try to protect their children from danger.

to assume that something is true
I suppose you're right.

keep away from or stop oneself from doing (something)
Try to avoid making the same mistake twice.

find, discover the position of
Can you help me locate my lost keys?

to be in a horizontal position; to say something untrue
He likes to lie on the sofa and read.

to lift or move to a higher position
Please raise your hand if you have a question.

to refer to something briefly and without going into detail
Did he mention anything about the meeting?

to continue to be in the same state or condition.
Please remain seated.

to obtain or acquire something
He hopes to gain more experience in this role.

to extend over a large or increasing area
The news spread quickly through the town.

to use or expend carelessly, extravagantly, or to no purpose
Don't waste food; eat everything on your plate.

bet
I wouldn't bet on that horse.

handle
She can handle difficult situations well.

improve
He wants to improve his English skills.

prevent
We need to prevent further damage.

remove
Please remove your shoes before entering.

shoot
Don't shoot the messenger.

prove
Can you prove that you were there?

to control, to succeed in doing
Can you manage to finish the report by Friday?

to attach, to pierce
Please stick the poster on the wall.

to be real, to live
Do aliens really exist?

to control the functioning of a machine, process, or system
You need to learn how to operate this machine.

to put forward for consideration
I suggest we take a break now.

to behave towards or deal with in a certain way
Please treat others with respect.

to recognize the full worth of
I really appreciate your help.

make smaller or less in amount
We need to reduce our expenses.

to move from one place to another
Please transfer the files to the new folder.

to make progress
The army began to advance towards the enemy.

plan, mean to do
I intend to finish this project by Friday.

to start or send off
They plan to launch a new product next month.

to put together
You can combine these ingredients.

to hold or include
The box contains old letters.

to copy data from one computer system to another
I need to download the new software update.

to show a feeling or opinion
It's important to express your feelings.

to move steadily and continuously
The river flows into the sea.

to carry out, accomplish, or entertain
The band will perform tonight.

to choose
Please select your preferred option.

to state or show that something is true
Can you confirm your reservation?

talk about something
Let's discuss this issue later.

maintain
It's important to maintain a healthy diet.
